<details>
<summary>Config.yml</summary>

# NXVanish - config (clean)

```
InvisibilityFeatures:
NightVision: true
DisableDamage: true
DisableHunger: true
DisableMobTarget: true
PreventCreeperDamageNearVanished: true
ExplosionIgnoreRadius: 8.0
AllowBlockBreak: false
AllowBlockPlace: false
DisableFireDamage: true
DisableExplosionDamage: true
DisableCrystalDamage: true
DisableAnchorDamage: true
AllowEntityDamage: true
AllowChatWhileVanished: false
AllowPickupItems: false
Fly:
Enable: true
DisableOnReappear: true

VanishStateFeatures:
AutoVanishOnJoin: true
ReappearOnWorldChange: false
ReappearOnQuit: false
SaveVanishOnRejoin: true

IndicationFeatures:
EnableBossBar: false
EnableActionBar: true
BossBarMessage: '&bYou are in vanish'
ActionBarMessage: '&a&lYOU ARE VANISHED!'
BossBarColor: BLUE
BossBarStyle: SOLID
ActionBarIntervalTicks: 40

MessageOptions:
UseMessagesYml: true
SendJoinQuitFakeMessages: true
AnnounceVanishReappearToAdmins: true
HideRealJoinQuitMessages: true

RestrictiveOptions:
PreventBlockBreaking: false
PreventBlockPlacing: true
PreventHittingEntities: false

MiscellaneousOptions:
UpdateChecker: true
NotifyAdmins: true

```
</details>

**Discord Server Link:-** https://discord.gg/JgbxKdF9xw

**Commands:-**
/nxvanish,
 /nv, 
/v, 
/fly, 
/nxvanishreload, 
/nxvanishalerts


<details>
<summary>text transcript</summary>

NxVanish The Best Vanish Plugin Ever.

WHAT IS NXVANISH? NxVanish is the best invisible plugin, fully configurable!

ACTION BAR & BOSS BAR SUPPORT You can enable or disable it from config.yml

EASY TO USE This plugin is very easy to use and fully customizable

BUILD IN FLY SUPPORT Our plugin have build in /fly support no other plugin is needed for fly

ACTION PREVENTION SUPPORT This plugin have action prevention support in vanish, like you can enable or disable block breaking, placing or damage any mob, from the config.yml

VANISH ALERT SYSTEM Nxvanish have vanish alert system, if someone vanish or unvanish, you will recive a notification.

PERMISSION BASED nxvanish.use or nxvanish.vanish

DAMAGE PREVENTION IN VANISH MODE you will don't get any type of damage in vanish you can change it from config.yml

ADMIN COMMANDS Admin commands to reload plugin config.

</details>



**Placeholders:-**

%nxvanish_is_vanished% Returns true or false depending on whether the player is vanished 

%nxvanish_vanished_count% Shows how many players are currently vanished 

%nxvanish_vanished_list% Lists all vanished players’ names (comma-separated)  %nxvanish_status%
Returns a text value — “Vanished” or “Visible” 

%nxvanish_prefix% Displays vanish prefix from messages.yml (like [V]) 

%nxvanish_suffix% Displays vanish suffix (if defined)
